title: Superstrip Algebras and Nonperturbative Spectra in Fermionic Theories
summary: This is an extended version of arXiv:2511.22129. We develop a general construction of the superstrip algebra $\mathbf{sStr}_{\mathscr C}(\mathcal M)$, the fermionic counterpart of the strip algebra, for a gapped $(1+1)$-dimensional system with a fermionic superfusion category $\mathscr C$ and the vacuum structure described by the supermodule category $\mathcal M$. As illustrations, we work out the superstrip algebra for two simple examples: the fermionic variant of the Fibonacci fusion category and the q-type $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry.
